data.rationale: The proposal follows the same sequence and goal (Wikipedia, timeanddate, Booking, Viator, OpenTable, Notes, Mail), but it omits the 8+ review-score hotel criterion, the note-taking of activity names and prices, the first available evening time (it hardcodes 18:30), and the guests count for OpenTable. It also lumps the activities into a list, leaves the Discard step ambiguous ("discard or send"), and uses "chosen" results where the true workflow says "first", so an automation would need guesswork.
